Redaction idempotence is proven only over one sample per pattern plus one combined string, not over a real workspace corpus.
CancelRun in grpc.rs discards the returned WorkspaceUploadOutcome, so a cancelled run's unsaved workspace is counted but never told to the user; a later slice that owns grpc.rs may surface it.
settle_workspace_outcome's signature in sandbox_lease.rs is longer than 100 columns and was not rustfmt-checked because the file is CRLF; wrap it when the file is next touched.

The 'Workspace changes were not saved.' line is appended to response.final_output after finalize has persisted the answer (agent.rs ~1865), so the durable thread copy lacks it while the streamed answer (model-gateway sse.rs:11232) carries it; the owner must decide whether the flag-on path needs a second persist or a finalize reorder.

The row's record_workspace_outcome in state.rs was not built; the outcome is returned from release_sandbox_lease_if_any instead (state.rs untouched), which serves the agent.rs caller, but the CancelRun caller at grpc.rs:1582 discards it, so a cancelled run's unsaved workspace is counted yet never told to the user; accept the deviation and record it on the plan row.

diff_and_upload still computes sha256_digest(&redacted) instead of calling content_version as the row requires, so content_version and would_redact have no non-test caller and the digest rule exists twice in workspace_hydrate.rs; content_version_equals_cas_put_hash guards equality, so this is a wiring gap rather than a correctness bug.

The notice fires on every uploaded=false outcome, including a credential failure where no diff ran, so a run that changed nothing can be told its changes were not saved; the row says 'when changes were made', so this over-reports in the unknown state (agent.rs ~1864, sandbox_lease.rs credential branch).

On the credential-failure path the hydrated plaintext Space workspace directory is left on disk until restart (pre-existing behaviour, now reported as unsaved), so Space content stays on host disk after a failed release.
No test covers the success path where SnapshotSandbox accepts a non-empty changed set (uploaded=true and snapshot_recorded=true), which needs a sandbox-manager gRPC mock.
redaction_is_idempotent_over_fixture_corpus uses one sample per pattern plus one combined string, which covers the nine string and two capture patterns in scrub.rs but no real workspace content.

RPC store failures return the fixed Internal message but are not logged, because server.go has no slog import, so a database outage on the read path is invisible in logs while the HTTP handlers do log.
Audit rows go to registry_audit_log with action skill_bundle.uploaded/deleted rather than through the WS06 hash-chained emitter that the row names; re-point the two write sites when WS06-S2 ships.

No test uploads a zero-byte file; the blob INSERT binds the file body as bytea[] and relies on io.ReadAll returning a non-nil empty slice, so a future change that yields nil would hit the NOT NULL constraint.
Parse counts directory entries against MaxFiles (len(reader.File) > 256 before directories are skipped), so a 256-file bundle that also stores directory entries is refused as too_many_files.
ListSkillBundles accepts an unbounded skill_ids list that is passed straight into the SQL array; a length cap would match the other list inputs.
gofmt reports a pre-existing misalignment in mcpServerRow in registry_apis.go (present at HEAD, outside this slice's hunks); it is not caused by this change.

results.notes: Fix round for the reviewer's finding: the three read RPCs now exist in internal/server/server.go, so the proto no longer answers Unimplemented once the generated code is regenerated. ListSkillBundles, GetSkillBundleManifest and GetSkillBlob each call verifiedOrganizationID first (unauthenticated refused before the switch is read), then answer an empty list or codes.NotFound while the switch is off, and map skillbundle.Summary, Manifest and blob to the new messages. The Server gets a skillBundles field (narrow interface skillBundleReader, which *skillbundle.Store satisfies) and skillBundlesEnabled, set by WithSkillBundles(store, enabled). The switch is parsed once by api.SkillBundlesAPIFromLookup and passed in, so server.go reads no env var. Store failures map to a fixed Internal message via skillBundleErr, so SQL text never reaches the caller. In-tree compile is still blocked until the lead regenerates the gen files and applies the main.go shared edit; both were verified only through a go build overlay in the scratchpad, and the worktree gen files and cmd/main.go were not touched. Regeneration used buf 1.72 with local protoc-gen-go v1.36.12 and protoc-gen-go-grpc v1.6.2, the versions in the current gen headers.
